## 📝 Summary
_What does this PR do and why?_
Adds a sandbox policy simulation API endpoint to allow users to test policy decisions
before deployment.
This PR introduces a stub implementation that defines the API contract, request/response
schemas, and exposes the endpoint via OpenAPI. Actual PDP integration will be implemented
in a follow-up issue.
